supersedes: Image selection part of copau-f8-java-policy-proposal-2026-10-20.json; original remains immutable.

selection.digest_kind: linux/amd64 image manifest, not image config or multi-platform index

public_source.revision_encoding: Upstream revision is base64 and URL-percent-encoded to distinguish it from a local repository commit claim; decode to retrieve immutable public metadata.
public_source.observed_by: GitHub read-only connector; no registry pull, image execution or signature operation

offline_design.choice: Keep this exact toolchain image unchanged; place a separately retained and hash-bound public dependency/support capsule in the allow-listed workspace. No derived image digest is needed or invented.
offline_design.worker_environment_identity: Exact image manifest digest plus committed raw workspace manifest, including every retained capsule file hash.
offline_design.integrated_image_alternative: If packaging dependencies inside a derived image is later required, its final digest can only come from a real CI build/registry publication. This upstream digest must never be called that derived-image digest.

backend_compatibility.fixed_launcher: CandidateBuildBackend passes the fixed /bin/sh -ec copy launcher as image arguments. CI must verify actual pinned entrypoint execs these arguments under numeric nonroot/read-only settings.
backend_compatibility.maven_writable_paths: Explicit -Dmaven.repo.local and -Duser.home under /tmp/factory-build. The upstream /root/.m2 setup may emit its nonfatal permission message; it must not cause a writable-root exception or require a root user.
backend_compatibility.architecture: Existing backend has no --platform policy field. Require a native linux/amd64 CI runner for this platform-specific manifest; a different architecture needs its own reviewed digest.
backend_compatibility.pull_scope: Controller/CI may acquire the pinned public image before worker creation; worker egress stays none.
